skill_name: Given a list of characters and actions, organize the characters and actions into an entertaining storyline.
workflow: Sheryl is a lawyer who wins the lottery one day and decides to use her newfound wealth to travel the world. During her travels, she meets Sarah, an engineer who has invented a revolutionary new technology. Sheryl and Sarah team up to help stop a local bank robbery. With their combined problem solving skills, they manage to thwart the criminal and ensure the safety of everyone in the bank.
